desc.en: An aerial type Slag, made to imitate a dragon. Its flight ability is more optimized than other Slags of the same type, and one must rely on intuition to predict its attacks, rather than sight, when fighting it.
desc.ja: 竜を模した飛行タイプのスラグ。同種のスラグよりも飛行能力に特化しており、戦うためには目で動きを捉えるのではなく、勘で行動を予測する必要がある
